then: Resend same approved invoice artifact only; no second invoice and no change to milestone or receipt states.

given: Cancellation requested after external invoice acceptance
then: Do not mark invoice nonexistent; reconcile and route authorized correction. Keep sticky cancellation for undispatched follow-on actions.

given: Contract amendment changes value after partial payment
then: Keep old invoices/receipts; revised obligations need approved evidence. Recompute new-version cash target and expectation; do not reinterpret prior payments or reissue stages automatically.

given: Delivery attempt1 succeeded, attempt2 later fails
then: Retain delivered aggregate for exact artifact/destination; preserve failed attempt separately, no invoice or cash state change.

given: Payment denominator zero or source manifest omits reversal
then: Unknown/blocked result; never passing percentage from zero denominator or incomplete caller-selected snapshot.

given: Schedule cancelled while invoice worker is waiting
then: Sticky cancellation prevents new issuance; externally accepted invoice remains under Finance correction and no cash reversal occurs.

given: Caller submits receipt.record with verification_state verified
then: Reject extra lifecycle field; trusted Finance verification is a separate command.

given: Result reports completed with null result
